verdicts.reason: A is basically the original shrunk evenly. The headline is centred on the big tooth with the woman beside it, so it stays faithful, but the 'DENTAL SERVICES' text is very small at 320x50 and the edge teeth are cropped awkwardly. B puts the headline on one larger line at the top left, but the big tooth butts against the end of 'SERVICES' and the woman is shrunk to a speck. The decorative teeth are packed into a row of tiny fragments under the text, leaving the bottom right empty, so the airy feel of the original is lost.
